sum: The Beachbody Company, Inc. operates as a fitness and nutrition company in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and France. The company operates Beachbody on Demand Interactive, a streaming service through subscription that provides fitness and nutrition content, including P90X, Insanity, 21 Day Fix, 80 Day Obsession, Morning Meltdown 100, LIIFT4, Unstress Meditations, Portion Fix, 4 Weeks of Focus, Sure Thing, Dig Deeper, Track Pilate, 2B Mindset, Insanity, P90X, Yoga52, and other brands. It also provides nutritional products, such as Shakeology, a nutrition shake; and Beachbody Performance supplements comprising pre-workout energize, hydrate, post-workout recover. The Beachbody Company, Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in El Segundo, California.
ceo: Mr. Carl D. Daikeler (Co-Founder, CEO & Director)
